sub_patterns.name: 简短有力
sub_patterns.description: 用最少的词语传达最核心的信息，句子简短，直奔主题

sub_patterns.name: 制造停顿和戏剧效果
sub_patterns.description: 在关键信息前使用省略号或停顿，制造期待和戏剧性

examples.en: An iPod, a phone, and an internet communicator... Are you getting it?
examples.zh: 一个iPod、一部手机、一个互联网通讯器……你们明白了吗？

sub_patterns.name: 三段式结构
sub_patterns.description: 用三个并列的结构组织论述，产生节奏感和完整性

examples.en: It's an iPod. It's a phone. And it's an internet communicator.
examples.zh: 它是一个iPod。它是一部手机。它还是一个互联网通讯器。

examples.en: The broader one's understanding of the human experience, the better design we will have.
examples.zh: 对人类经验的理解越广泛，我们就能做出越好的设计。

sub_patterns.name: 对比句式
sub_patterns.description: 通过对比来突出观点，制造鲜明的反差效果

examples.en: Design is not just what it looks like and feels like. Design is how it works.
examples.zh: 设计不仅仅是看起来怎样、感觉怎样。设计是它如何运作。

examples.en: If you keep your eye on the profit, you're going to skimp on the product. But if you focus on making really great products, the profit will follow.
examples.zh: 如果你盯着利润，你就会在产品上偷工减料。但如果你专注于做出真正伟大的产品，利润自然会随之而来。

sub_patterns.name: 重复强调
sub_patterns.description: 通过重复关键短语来制造强调效果

examples.en: An iPod, a phone, and an internet communicator... An iPod, a phone, and an internet communicator...
examples.zh: 一个iPod、一部手机、一个互联网通讯器……一个iPod、一部手机、一个互联网通讯器……

sub_patterns.name: 直接而尖锐
sub_patterns.description: 不使用模糊词，批评具体而非笼统，用极端形容词表达不满

examples.en: This is the worst design I've ever seen.
examples.zh: 这是我所见过的最糟糕的设计。

sub_patterns.name: 吝啬但真诚
sub_patterns.description: 赞美频率极低但极具分量，简短直接

examples.en: This is the best work you've ever done.
examples.zh: 这是你做过的最好的作品。

sub_patterns.name: 不回答不想回答的问题
sub_patterns.description: 用转移话题、重新定义问题或反问来回避

sub_patterns.name: 冷幽默
sub_patterns.description: 面无表情地说出幽默的话，不带夸张表情

examples.en: I'm the only person I know that's lost a quarter of a billion dollars in one year... It's very character-building.
examples.zh: 我是我认识的人中唯一一个在一年内亏掉两亿五千万美元的……这非常锻炼品格。

sub_patterns.name: 讽刺
sub_patterns.description: 用夸张比喻和对比来讽刺竞争对手或平庸产品

examples.en: Microsoft's only problem is they have no taste. They have absolutely no taste.
examples.zh: 微软唯一的问题是他们没有品味。他们绝对没有品味。
